# Capability matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_capability_matrix.py from the code registries it
names. Do not edit by hand: change the code or the curated rows in that script,
then run `python scripts/gen_capability_matrix.py`. tests/test_capability_matrix.py
fails when this file is stale. -->

What gpo-lens does with each part of a collected estate. The verbs are used
strictly:

- **Parses** — ingest turns the input into normalized `Setting` rows that
  search, ledgers, exports, diffs and baseline/golden comparison use.
- **Flags** — a detector raises a finding (Findings inbox, `doctor`).
- **Resolves** — the OU-level resultant and principal resultant merge settings
  across the precedence chain with a defined per-CSE rule. Resolution is over
  *collected inputs at OU level*; it is never live RSoP.
- **Does not support** — listed at the end; nothing here simulates it.

## Flags: finding detectors

Source: `gpo_lens.findings.INTRINSIC_DETECTOR_VERSIONS`, the registry of every executed intrinsic check (findings are emitted by `queries.estate_doctor` and `danger.danger_findings`).

| Finding category | Detector version | What it flags |
|------------------|------------------|---------------|
| `admx_gap` | 2 | Registry settings without a loaded ADMX template (one finding per GPO) |
| `audit_parse_warning` | 1 | Advanced Audit evidence the parser could not fully classify |
| `audit_source_disagreement` | 1 | Duplicate Advanced Audit subcategory values disagree |
| `broken_ref:*` | 2 | Malformed path, or a script / scheduled-task path / GPP file reference missing from the GPO's own collected SYSVOL (`malformed_path`, `missing_script`, `scheduled_task_path`, `gpp_file_ref`); external UNC and machine-local paths are inventoried, never flagged |
| `broken_wmi_ref` | 1 | GPO references a WMI filter that is not in the export |
| `coverage_gap` | 1 | GPO missing from the export versus `gpo-inventory.json`, a `collection-errors.json` entry, missing SYSVOL (GPP/cpassword detectors blind), or an unreadable Preferences subtree |
| `cpassword` | 2 | `cpassword` attribute in a known GPP XML file in collected SYSVOL (MS14-025) |
| `danger:audit_subcategory_override` | 1 | Advanced Audit subcategories authored without the force-subcategory option in the same GPO (authoring caveat; not a device-level claim) |
| `danger:gpo_owner_nonadmin` | 1 | GPO owned by a non-admin trustee |
| `danger:gpo_writable_nonadmin` | 1 | GPO writable by a non-admin trustee |
| `danger:local_admin_push` | 1 | GPO pushes local Administrators membership |
| `danger:overbroad_apply_gp` | 1 | Apply Group Policy granted to Everyone / Anonymous |
| `danger:setting_rules` | 1 | Setting-value rules from `danger_rules.toml` (next table) |
| `dangling_link` | 1 | Link to a GPO that is not in the export |
| `deny_ace` | 1 | Deny ACE on a GPO |
| `disabled_but_populated` | 1 | A disabled side (Computer/User) still carries settings |
| `empty` | 1 | GPO with no readable settings on either side |
| `enforced_link` | 1 | Enforced (No Override) link |
| `excessive_writer` | 1 | Non-default trustee with write access to 5 or more GPOs |
| `ilt_gpo` | 1 | Item-level targeting (`<Filters>`) in GPP XML; flagged, never evaluated |
| `legacy_extension` | 1 | Deprecated Internet Explorer Maintenance extension (informational) |
| `ms16_072` | 1 | GPO without Authenticated Users / Domain Computers Read (MS16-072) |
| `orphaned_wmi_filter` | 1 | WMI filter no GPO references |
| `pki_parse_warning` | 1 | Public Key evidence the parser could not fully classify |
| `stale_gpo` | 1 | Linked GPO last modified more than 2 years ago |
| `topology_discrepancy` | 1 | `ou-tree.json` and `gp-inheritance.json` disagree (block-inheritance mismatch, OU missing from SOMs, unparseable gPLink) |
| `unlinked` | 1 | GPO with no links (applies nowhere) |
| `version_skew` | 1 | AD (GPC) and SYSVOL (GPT) version counters disagree for a side |

## Flags: setting-value danger rules

Source: the shipped `src/gpo_lens/danger_rules.toml` (finding category `danger:<id>`). `GPO_LENS_DANGER_RULES_DIR` can add or override rules at run time; those are not listed here.

| Rule id | Severity | Side | Registry identity | Title | Reference |
|---------|----------|------|-------------------|-------|-----------|
| `autoadmin_logon` | critical | Machine | `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon:AutoAdminLogon` | Automatic logon enabled (plaintext credential storage) | <https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1078/> |
| `lm_hash_enabled` | high | Machine | `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa:NoLMHash` | LM hash storage enabled | <https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/002/> |
| `ntlmv1_allowed` | high | Machine | `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa:LmCompatibilityLevel` | NTLMv1 allowed (weak authentication) | <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/security/ntlm/ntlm-authentication/> |
| `smb_signing_disabled` | high | Machine | `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanWorkstation\Parameters:RequireSecuritySignature` | SMB client signing disabled (relay risk) | <https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1557/001/> |
| `wdigest_creds` | critical | Machine | `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa:UseLogonCredential` | WDigest plaintext credential caching | <https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/001/> |

## Parses: collector inputs

Source: `gpo_lens.ingest.load_estate`. An optional JSON input that is absent or unparseable is skipped with a Python warning (`_try_load`), not a finding; only the inputs noted below create `coverage_gap` findings.

| Input | Reader (`gpo_lens.ingest`) | Notes |
|-------|----------------------------|-------|
| `AllGPOs.xml` | `parse_report` | Required; missing or unparseable fails the ingest |
| `gp-inheritance.json` | `parse_inheritance` | Optional |
| `sites.json` | `parse_sites` | Optional; adds `site` SOMs |
| `gpo-metadata.json` | `merge_metadata` | Optional |
| `SYSVOL-Policies/ (or SYSVOL/Policies/)` | `attach_sysvol_paths` | Optional; absence is a `coverage_gap` (GPP/cpassword detectors blind) |
| `Machine\|User/Registry.pol in SYSVOL` | `augment_blocked_registry_from_pol` | Optional |
| `Machine/.../Audit/audit.csv in SYSVOL` | `augment_audit_from_csv` | Optional |
| `wmi-filters.json` | `parse_wmi_filters` | Optional |
| `ou-tree.json` | `parse_ou_tree` | Optional |
| `gpo-inventory.json, collection-errors.json` | `parse_coverage_gaps` | Optional; drive `coverage_gap` reconciliation |
| `principals.json` | `parse_principals` | Optional |
| `group-members.json` | `parse_group_members` | Optional |

## Parses and resolves: client-side extensions

Every CSE in the GPMC report is parsed at least generically; the parser column names the `gpo_lens.ingest` functions that build its settings. The resolution column is `gpo_lens.merge.cse_merge_mode(<name>)` evaluated on the name exactly as listed. Some resolution modes depend on a per-setting flag (Restricted Groups members vs. member-of; Folder Redirection merge vs. replace).

| CSE (report name) | Parsing | Parser functions | Resolution |
|-------------------|---------|------------------|------------|
| Registry | Administrative Template policies and registry values by `key:value` identity; ADMX/ADML names when templates are loaded; a `<Blocked/>` extension is resolved from a collected `Registry.pol` | `_parse_admin_template_policy`, `_parse_classic_registry_setting`, `_parse_registry_setting`, `_parse_gpp_registry`, `augment_blocked_registry_from_pol` | `last_writer_wins` — resolved: highest-precedence GPO wins per identity |
| Security | Account policies, user rights, security options, restricted groups and other security-template entries | `_parse_security_setting` | `last_writer_wins` — resolved: highest-precedence GPO wins per identity |
| Advanced Audit Configuration | Subcategory GUID identities and named audit values, reconciled with a copied `audit.csv`; disagreements and unclassified evidence stay visible | `_parse_audit_setting`, `augment_audit_from_csv` | `approximate` — **approximate**: precedence order applied and the row marked `approximate`; no CSE-specific rule |
| Public Key | EFS, root certificate trust, autoenrollment, path validation and certificate entries; unrecognized structures are kept as `blocked` evidence | `_parse_public_key` | `approximate` — **approximate**: precedence order applied and the row marked `approximate`; no CSE-specific rule |
| Folder Redirection | One setting per redirected folder | `_parse_folder_redirection` | `merge_replace_flag` — resolved per setting flag (merge vs. replace) |
| Scripts | Generic element parse | `_parse_generic_setting` | `union` — resolved: all GPOs' entries apply |
| Software Installation | Generic element parse | `_parse_generic_setting` | `accumulate` — resolved: entries accumulate across GPOs |
| Drive Maps | One setting per GPP item | `_parse_gpp_container` | `approximate` — **approximate**: precedence order applied and the row marked `approximate`; no CSE-specific rule |
| Printers | One setting per GPP item | `_parse_gpp_container` | `accumulate` — resolved: entries accumulate across GPOs |
| Scheduled Tasks | One setting per GPP item | `_parse_gpp_container` | `approximate` — **approximate**: precedence order applied and the row marked `approximate`; no CSE-specific rule |
| Files | One setting per GPP item | `_parse_gpp_container` | `accumulate` — resolved: entries accumulate across GPOs |
| Folders | One setting per GPP item | `_parse_gpp_container` | `accumulate` — resolved: entries accumulate across GPOs |
| Services | One setting per GPP item | `_parse_gpp_container` | `accumulate` — resolved: entries accumulate across GPOs |
| Internet Explorer Maintenance | Kept as `legacy_deprecated` evidence with an informational note | `_readable_identity` | `approximate` — **approximate**: precedence order applied and the row marked `approximate`; no CSE-specific rule |
| Wireless | Generic element parse | `_parse_generic_setting` | `single_winner` — resolved: one GPO's policy object wins |
| (any other CSE) | Generic element parse with a readable identity; a non-Registry `<Blocked/>` extension stays opaque and is flagged | `_parse_generic_setting` | `approximate` — **approximate**: precedence order applied and the row marked `approximate`; no CSE-specific rule |

## Parses: GPP XML files scanned in collected SYSVOL

Source: `gpo_lens.detection._gpp._GPP_XML_FILES`. These files (under `Machine|User/Preferences/`, either nested per CSE or flat) feed the cpassword scan, the scheduled-task and local-group inventories (Explore), and broken reference checks; item-level targeting is detected in any Preferences XML. Without a SYSVOL copy these detectors are blind, which is itself a `coverage_gap` finding.

`Groups.xml`, `Services.xml`, `Drives.xml`, `ScheduledTasks.xml`, `DataSources.xml`, `Printers.xml`, `Folders.xml`, `Files.xml`, `Registry.xml`, `Environment.xml`, `Shortcuts.xml`, `InternetSettings.xml`, `Regional.xml`, `PowerOptions.xml`, `NetworkShares.xml`, `LocalUsersAndGroups.xml`, `EventLogs.xml`

## Does not support

From the README "Limits" and the "Flag, don't simulate" rule in `AGENTS.md`:

- **Live or per-object RSoP.** WMI filter truth, item-level targeting and
  loopback runtime behavior are flagged as caveats, never evaluated. The tool
  does not observe what a Windows client applied.
- **Per-machine site membership.** Site-linked GPOs are captured as `site`
  SOMs and flagged; subnet/site resolution per machine is not done, and site
  GPOs are excluded from OU precedence views.
- **More than one estate per database.** Multi-domain, multi-forest and
  cross-estate comparison are not supported.
- **Opaque `<Blocked/>` extensions other than Registry.** They remain flagged
  as blocked.
- **Collection the collector account cannot see.** Coverage is bounded by the
  export; reconciliation needs the authoritative `gpo-inventory.json` supplied
  with that export.
- **External reachability.** UNC and machine-local paths are inventoried
  (Explore → dependencies) but never contacted or verified.
